card.name: Linking words before descriptive adjectives
card.fires_on: Small linking or adverb words such as "often", "a", "of", "and" that sit right before an adjective describing a person, group or thing in general web prose. Seen in biographies and history writing.

modes.label: often before adjective
modes.description: The adverb "often" comes right before a descriptive adjective about people or things.
modes.example: He sacked ministers and replaced them with people who were<< often>> young and inexperienced.

modes.label: link words in trait lists
modes.description: "a", "of", "and" or "them" appear before the next trait in a description of a person's skills or character.
modes.example: Boileau was a man<< of>> warm and kindly feelings, honest, outspoken

modes.label: verb or noun before a quality
modes.description: A verb or noun leads into a described quality or abstract demand.

card.writes: It pushes toward words of quality or skill like sophisticated, expert, complex and prestigious.
card.plain: It fires on the little word just before an adjective that describes what someone or something is like.
